scope: Bounded malformed OBJECTS-body recovery and CLI disposition controls for all six typed RENDERSETTINGS subtypes.

source.kind: scratch-only DWGs authored at test runtime by the in-tree DWG writer; each valid typed seed is converted to a raw mutated frame and injected with matching custom-class registration
source.bodyMutation: A one-bit mutation is selected inside the declared object body after preserving the validated common prologue. Environment AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 have no parser-failing one-bit mutation in the bounded body span searched; these generated profiles carry their substantive payload in the detached string stream.

implementation.controls: Every eligible generated source reads successfully with one object parse failure, zero entity parse failures, one failed object frame, exact source-frame accounting, and the following LINE callback. Strict ASCII/Binary conversion preserves the destination sentinel. Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion succeeds and reopens with the retained LINE and VPORT. AC1027 reader recovery passes, while both CLI modes stop at the established source-reference qualification gate.

results.outputQualification: Settings, Global, Entry, RapidRT, and MentalRay pass strict refusal plus explicit-partial ASCII/Binary readback at AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, and AC1032; their AC1027 profiles pass reader recovery but remain behind the source-reference gate for output. Environment passes strict refusal and explicit-partial ASCII/Binary readback at AC1015, AC1018, and AC1021.

validation.directControl: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --partial-read-only: PASS; 172 base strict/partial/readback controls, 28 controls each for VBA_PROJECT, GROUP, DICTIONARY, TV_DEVICE_PROPERTIES, POINTPATH, PARTIAL_VIEWING_INDEX, CURVEPATH, PLOTSETTINGS, PDF UNDERLAYDEFINITION, and VISUALSTYLE; 15 BLOCKREPRESENTATION_DATA controls; 18 controls each for VX_CONTROL and VX_TABLE_RECORD; 10 MATERIAL controls; and 155 RENDERSETTINGS controls (28 each for Settings, Global, Entry, RapidRT, MentalRay and 15 for Environment)

limitations: Generated parser-recovery and CLI disposition evidence only; it does not establish RENDERSETTINGS field semantics, native rendering behavior, producer prevalence, or interoperability.
Environment has generated malformed-body coverage only at AC1015/AC1018/AC1021 because the bounded one-bit body-span search found no parser-failing mutation for AC1024/AC1027/AC1032.
AC1027 output remains unqualified behind the source-reference closure gate for the five subtypes with AC1027 reader profiles.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
